content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts consistently underestimate prices in the short term, especially after bullish sentiment spikes.", "Sentiment shifts toward bullishness correlate with price overshoots in the following 30-day window.", "Forecast bias is amplified when official supply net is negative and event count is high.", "Model lag is evident when true prices rise sharply after auction events, suggesting delayed reaction to supply shocks.", "Sentiment and price movements show mean-reversion tendencies after sustained bullish periods.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment aligns with recent price trends, indicating sentiment-driven calibration.", "Overshoots are more likely when bullish sentiment exceeds 20% of total sentiment in the 18-day window.", "Model underestimates peak prices during high-event periods, suggesting insufficient adjustment for supply-demand imbalance."]}
